text: So, um, that said, in terms of coverage, we tried to give a classification of the different types of wireless technologies. Next, let's consider as criterion to classify our wireless networks the architecture. Okay, so now we focus on architecture as a criterion. And how can we now classify our networks? Well, our wireless network technologies may have, as already mentioned, different architectures. This is the example of Wi-Fi. So Wi-Fi, as we know, has got us the users that are wirelessly connected with the access point. And then on top of an access point, we have a router that connects the access point with the fixed network, cable network. This can be, for example, the campus network, or when you have your access point and router at home, then that's connected to the internet. 5G, this is the example of cellular network. Cellular network as an architecture has got users. It can be a vehicle with the cellular interface. It can be our phone that communicates in this case with a base station. And then the base station is connected with what is called the mobile.
